location.exact_quote: 主にイギリス英語の政治報道で用いる。

findings.rationale: C-003/F-004 directly supports the British-English label and the no-overall-majority condition, but the supplied fact and source detail do not support the narrower register claim that the expression is used mainly in political reporting.
findings.suggested_direction: Remove the unsupported restriction to political reporting (for example, retain only the supported British-English label), or bind a source fact that directly establishes that register limitation.
